name: Spinach and Tomato Omelet
instructions: ["Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.", "Cook spinach and diced tomato in a lightly oiled skillet until tender.", "Pour in the eggs, cook until nearly set, add cheese, fold, and serve."]

name: Cheesy Bell Pepper Frittata
instructions: ["Soften diced bell pepper and onion in an oven-safe skillet.", "Beat eggs, pour over the vegetables, and scatter cheese on top.", "Cook gently until set, finishing under a broiler if desired."]

name: Tomato Chickpea Stew
instructions: ["Cook chopped onion and garlic in a saucepan until fragrant.", "Add tomatoes and drained chickpeas; simmer for 20 minutes.", "Season to taste and serve warm."]

name: Chicken Spinach Skillet
instructions: ["Season chicken and cook in a hot skillet until browned and cooked through.", "Add garlic and a splash of water; stir in spinach until wilted.", "Finish with lemon juice and serve."]

name: Apple Yogurt Breakfast Bowl
instructions: ["Spoon yogurt into a bowl.", "Top with chopped apple and sliced banana.", "Add cinnamon or a little honey if available."]

name: Roasted Broccoli and Potato Bowl
instructions: ["Heat oven to 220 C / 425 F and cube the potatoes.", "Roast potatoes and broccoli with oil until browned and tender.", "Finish with cheese and lemon juice."]

name: Chicken and Rice Skillet
instructions: ["Brown bite-sized chicken pieces in a deep skillet.", "Add diced onion, carrot, rice, and broth or water.", "Cover and simmer until rice is tender and chicken is fully cooked."]

name: Tomato Mozzarella Salad
instructions: ["Slice tomatoes and tear spinach into bite-size pieces.", "Arrange with sliced mozzarella or other cheese.", "Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper."]

name: Black Bean and Bell Pepper Tacos
instructions: ["Cook sliced bell pepper and onion in a skillet until softened.", "Stir in drained black beans and chopped tomato; heat through.", "Serve in warm tortillas with your favorite toppings."]

name: Garlic Mushroom Pasta
instructions: ["Boil pasta according to its package directions and reserve a little pasta water.", "Cook sliced mushrooms with garlic until golden.", "Toss pasta with mushrooms, cheese, and enough pasta water to coat."]

name: Carrot Apple Slaw
instructions: ["Grate carrots and apple into a bowl.", "Mix yogurt with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.", "Toss together and chill briefly before serving."]

name: Spinach Mushroom Egg Scramble
instructions: ["Saute sliced mushrooms until their moisture cooks away.", "Add spinach and stir until wilted.", "Pour in beaten eggs, scramble gently, and finish with cheese."]

name: Salmon with Lemon Potato
instructions: ["Heat oven to 200 C / 400 F and cut potatoes into small pieces.", "Roast potatoes until nearly tender, then add seasoned salmon and broccoli.", "Bake until salmon flakes easily and finish with lemon."]

name: Avocado Tomato Toast
instructions: ["Toast slices of bread until crisp.", "Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.", "Spread on toast and top with sliced tomato."]

name: Chicken and Broccoli Pasta
instructions: ["Cook pasta and add broccoli for the final few minutes; drain.", "Cook diced chicken in a skillet until fully cooked.", "Combine pasta, broccoli, chicken, and cheese with a splash of cooking water."]

name: Chickpea Spinach Curry
instructions: ["Cook chopped onion with curry spices until soft.", "Add tomatoes and chickpeas; simmer for 15 minutes.", "Stir in spinach until wilted and serve with rice if available."]

name: Cheese and Vegetable Quesadilla
instructions: ["Cook diced bell pepper and onion until soft, then stir in spinach.", "Place vegetables and cheese on half of a tortilla and fold.", "Toast in a dry skillet on both sides until crisp and melty."]

name: Potato and Onion Hash with Eggs
instructions: ["Dice potatoes small and cook in an oiled skillet until browned and tender.", "Add sliced onion and bell pepper; cook until softened.", "Serve with eggs cooked to your preference."]

name: Strawberry Banana Yogurt Smoothie
instructions: ["Add strawberries, banana, yogurt, and milk to a blender.", "Blend until smooth, adding a little more milk to thin if needed.", "Serve immediately."]

name: Cucumber Tomato Yogurt Salad
instructions: ["Dice cucumber and tomato.", "Stir yogurt with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.", "Fold the vegetables into the dressing and serve chilled."]

name: Carrot Broccoli Soup
instructions: ["Chop carrot, broccoli, and onion into small pieces.", "Simmer vegetables in broth or water until tender.", "Blend until smooth, stir in milk, and season to taste."]

name: Chicken Avocado Salad
instructions: ["Cook chicken until its center reaches a safe temperature, then slice.", "Toss lettuce and tomato in a bowl.", "Top with chicken and avocado; dress with lemon and olive oil."]

name: Garlic Lemon Salmon
instructions: ["Season salmon with minced garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.", "Bake at 200 C / 400 F until the fish flakes easily.", "Serve with quickly wilted spinach."]

name: Apple Cheddar Snack Plate
instructions: ["Slice the apple and cheese.", "Cut the carrot into sticks.", "Arrange together and serve as a snack plate."]

name: Tomato Spinach Pasta
instructions: ["Cook pasta according to package directions.", "Warm chopped tomato and garlic in a skillet until saucy.", "Fold in spinach until wilted, toss with drained pasta, and season."]

name: Chickpea Carrot Salad
instructions: ["Drain chickpeas and grate the carrot.", "Chop cucumber and combine with chickpeas and carrot.", "Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper."]

name: Classic French Toast
instructions: ["Whisk egg and milk in a shallow dish.", "Dip bread slices into the egg mixture until coated.", "Melt butter in a pan and cook bread on medium heat until golden brown on both sides."]

name: Shakshuka with Poached Eggs
instructions: ["Saute onion, bell pepper, and garlic until tender.", "Add tomatoes and cumin; simmer into a thick spiced sauce.", "Create small wells in sauce, crack in eggs, cover, and gently cook until whites are set."]

name: Banana Oatmeal Pancakes
instructions: ["Blend banana, oats, egg, and milk until smooth.", "Pour batter onto a hot greased griddle.", "Flip once bubbles appear on the surface and cook through."]

name: Avocado Egg Breakfast Toast
instructions: ["Toast bread slices.", "Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.", "Fry or poach eggs to desired doneness.", "Spread avocado on toast and top with eggs."]

name: Cheese and Herb Scrambled Eggs
instructions: ["Whisk eggs with a splash of milk and seasoning.", "Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over low heat.", "Gently stir curds until soft and fold in grated cheese just before removing from heat."]

name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
instructions: ["Layer greek yogurt into a glass.", "Add sliced strawberries and blueberries.", "Drizzle lightly with honey and serve."]

name: Lemon Garlic Roasted Chicken
instructions: ["Rub chicken with olive oil, minced garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.", "Roast in preheated 200 C oven until golden and internal temperature reaches 74 C.", "Rest for 5 minutes before slicing."]

name: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: ["Slice chicken, bell peppers, and onion into thin strips.", "Stir-fry in hot skillet with fajita seasonings until chicken is cooked through.", "Squeeze fresh lime juice over skillet and serve in warm tortillas."]

name: Garlic Butter Chicken Thighs
instructions: ["Sear chicken thighs skin-side down in a hot skillet until crispy.", "Flip, baste with melted butter and minced garlic.", "Add spinach to the pan during final minutes to wilt in garlic butter."]

name: Ground Beef Fried Rice
instructions: ["Brown ground beef and drain excess fat.", "Saute diced onion and carrot in skillet.", "Add cooked rice, push to side, scramble in eggs, and toss with soy sauce."]

name: Classic Beef Bolognese Pasta
instructions: ["Brown beef with diced onion and garlic in a Dutch oven.", "Stir in tomatoes and simmer gently on low heat for 30 minutes.", "Toss with al dente cooked pasta and season."]

name: Pork and Broccoli Stir Fry
instructions: ["Slice pork thinly and toss with soy sauce and garlic.", "Sear pork in hot wok until browned.", "Add broccoli florets and a splash of water, cover to steam, and serve over rice."]

name: Turkey and Vegetable Skillet
instructions: ["Brown ground turkey in a large pan.", "Add sliced zucchini, diced bell pepper, and onion.", "Season with herbs and simmer until vegetables are crisp-tender."]

name: Sausage, Pepper and Potato Hash
instructions: ["Dice potatoes small and parboil or microwave 3 minutes.", "Slice sausage and brown in skillet.", "Add potatoes, bell pepper, and onion, cooking until edges are crisp and browned."]

name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: ["Season salmon fillets with salt and black pepper.", "Pan-sear in butter over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side.", "Add asparagus to the pan in the final 5 minutes, basting with lemon butter."]

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
instructions: ["Cook pasta until al dente.", "Saute peeled shrimp in foaming butter with minced garlic for 3 minutes.", "Toss pasta with shrimp, garlic butter, and fresh lemon juice."]

name: Classic Tuna Salad
instructions: ["Drain canned tuna and flake into a bowl.", "Add finely minced celery, red onion, and squeeze of lemon juice.", "Season with black pepper and serve over salad or bread."]

name: Salmon and Avocado Salad Bowl
instructions: ["Flake cooked salmon into bite-sized chunks.", "Arrange washed lettuce, sliced cucumber, and diced avocado in a bowl.", "Top with salmon and dress with olive oil and lemon juice."]

name: Classic Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: ["Saute chopped onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.", "Add tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes.", "Blend with an immersion blender and stir in cream."]

name: Loaded Black Bean Soup
instructions: ["Saute onion, bell pepper, and garlic in a soup pot.", "Add black beans with their liquid and vegetable broth.", "Simmer 15 minutes, mash some beans for thickness, and finish with lime juice."]

name: Hearty Lentil and Carrot Stew
instructions: ["Cook diced onion, carrot, and garlic in olive oil.", "Rinse lentils and add to pot along with crushed tomatoes and broth.", "Simmer for 30 minutes until lentils and carrots are tender."]

name: Potato Leek and Carrot Soup
instructions: ["Sweat diced onion and carrots in melted butter.", "Add cubed potatoes and water or broth; bring to a boil.", "Simmer until tender, blend smooth, and stir in milk."]

name: Creamy Tomato Penne
instructions: ["Cook penne pasta in salted boiling water.", "Simmer crushed tomatoes with garlic, then stir in heavy cream to make pink sauce.", "Toss pasta with sauce and parmesan cheese."]

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: ["Heat wok with oil over high heat.", "Saute diced onion, carrots, and peas.", "Add chilled cooked rice, scramble egg into the side, and stir together with soy sauce."]

name: Mushroom and Spinach Risotto
instructions: ["Saute diced onion and sliced mushrooms in oil until golden.", "Toast arborio rice in pan, then gradually ladle in warm broth while stirring.", "Fold in fresh spinach and grated parmesan when rice is tender."]

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
instructions: ["Cook quinoa according to package instructions and cool.", "Dice cucumber and tomatoes, crumble feta cheese.", "Toss quinoa with vegetables, lemon juice, and olive oil."]

name: Stir-Fried Garlic Cabbage and Carrots
instructions: ["Shred cabbage and slice carrots into thin matchsticks.", "Heat oil in wok, fry minced garlic until fragrant.", "Add cabbage and carrots, tossing quickly over high heat with soy sauce."]

name: Roasted Zucchini and Bell Pepper Medley
instructions: ["Chop zucchini, bell peppers, and onion into uniform chunks.", "Toss with olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper.", "Roast at 215 C / 425 F for 20 minutes until caramelized."]

name: Cauliflower and Potato Curry
instructions: ["Saute onion and garlic with curry spices.", "Add cubed potatoes, cauliflower florets, and tomatoes with a splash of water.", "Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until potatoes are fork-tender."]

name: Creamy Mashed Potatoes with Garlic
instructions: ["Peel and cube potatoes, boil in salted water until very tender.", "Drain and mash potatoes thoroughly.", "Fold in warm milk, melted butter, and roasted or minced garlic."]

name: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
instructions: ["Simmer rolled oats in milk over medium heat for 5 minutes.", "Dice apple into small pieces and stir in with cinnamon.", "Drizzle with honey and serve warm."]

name: Crispy Baked Potato Wedges
instructions: ["Cut potatoes lengthwise into wedges.", "Toss with olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.", "Bake skin-down at 220 C / 425 F for 30 minutes until golden and crisp."]

name: Simple Tomato Cucumber Bruschetta
instructions: ["Toast thick slices of rustic bread and rub with a raw garlic clove.", "Finely dice ripe tomatoes and cucumber.", "Toss vegetables with olive oil, spoon over toast, and sprinkle with salt."]

name: Garlic Sauteed Spinach and Mushrooms
instructions: ["Slice mushrooms and saute in olive oil until browned.", "Add minced garlic and stir for 30 seconds.", "Toss in fresh spinach, cook until just wilted, and season with salt and pepper."]

name: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: ["Cook seasoned chicken strips and sliced vegetables.", "Layer chicken, vegetables, and shredded cheese on tortillas.", "Fold and toast in skillet until cheese melts."]

name: Guacamole with Chips
instructions: ["Mash ripe avocados with fresh lime juice and salt.", "Stir in finely diced red onion and tomato.", "Serve with crispy baked tortilla wedges."]

name: Beef and Bean Burrito Bowl
instructions: ["Cook seasoned ground beef and heat black beans.", "Layer warm rice in bowls, top with beef, beans, and fresh diced tomatoes.", "Sprinkle with cheese and chopped green onion."]

name: Fish Tacos with Lime Cabbage Slaw
instructions: ["Season whitefish fillets and pan-sear until flaked.", "Toss shredded cabbage with lime juice and Greek yogurt.", "Assemble fish in tortillas and top with crunchy lime slaw."]

name: Huevos Rancheros
instructions: ["Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.", "Simmer crushed tomatoes and onions into a ranchero salsa.", "Fry eggs sunny side up, place over tortillas with warm beans and spoon salsa over top."]

name: Caprese Sandwich
instructions: ["Slice rustic bread and fresh mozzarella.", "Layer thick tomato slices and fresh mozzarella on bread with basil leaves.", "Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with salt, and close sandwich."]

name: Pasta Carbonara with Bacon
instructions: ["Cook pasta al dente, reserving half cup of starchy water.", "Crisp diced bacon in a skillet.", "Whisk eggs with grated cheese, take pan off heat, toss pasta with bacon and egg mixture quickly to create creamy sauce."]

name: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: ["Slice eggplant, coat in breadcrumbs and bake until tender.", "Simmer crushed tomatoes with garlic.", "Layer eggplant, tomato sauce, and cheese in a baking dish and bake at 190 C until bubbling."]

name: Greek Village Salad
instructions: ["Chop cucumbers, ripe tomatoes, and red onion into chunky pieces.", "Top with a slab of feta cheese.", "Dress generously with extra virgin olive oil, salt, and oregano."]

name: Lemon Rosemary Chicken and Potatoes
instructions: ["Cut potatoes into wedges and arrange with chicken in roasting pan.", "Drizzle with olive oil, minced garlic, lemon juice, and seasonings.", "Roast at 200 C for 40 minutes until chicken is golden and potatoes tender."]

name: Minestrone Vegetable Soup
instructions: ["Saute diced onion, carrot, and celery until fragrant.", "Add canned tomatoes, broth, and simmer 20 minutes.", "Add small pasta and cook until tender; season to taste."]

name: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Risotto
instructions: ["Saute finely minced onion and garlic in butter.", "Add arborio rice and toast 2 minutes.", "Gradually stir in warm vegetable or chicken broth one ladle at a time until creamy, fold in parmesan."]

name: Chicken Teriyaki with Steamed Rice
instructions: ["Simmer soy sauce, minced garlic, and sugar into a glossy teriyaki glaze.", "Pan-sear bite-sized chicken until cooked, coat in teriyaki sauce.", "Serve with steamed rice and tender broccoli florets."]

name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: ["Press and cube tofu, pan-fry until golden on all sides.", "Stir-fry bell peppers and broccoli with minced garlic.", "Toss tofu and vegetables in soy sauce and serve over rice."]

name: Beef and Broccoli
instructions: ["Slice beef thinly against the grain.", "Stir-fry beef in hot wok with garlic until browned.", "Add broccoli florets and soy sauce mixture, cook until tender-crisp, serve with rice."]

name: Egg Drop Soup
instructions: ["Bring chicken broth to a gentle simmer with a splash of soy sauce.", "Lightly whisk eggs in a cup.", "Slowly drizzle eggs in a circular motion into hot broth while gently stirring to form ribbons, garnish with green onion."]

name: Korean Style Kimchi Fried Rice
instructions: ["Chop kimchi and saute in a hot skillet with a dash of oil.", "Add chilled day-old rice and toss with kimchi and a drizzle of soy sauce.", "Top with a crispy sunny-side-up egg and sliced green onion."]

name: Sesame Peanut Noodles
instructions: ["Boil pasta noodles until tender and drain.", "Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, minced garlic, and warm water into a smooth sauce.", "Toss noodles in sauce and top with cool julienned cucumber."]

name: Cabbage and Pork Dumpling Skillet
instructions: ["Brown ground pork with minced garlic, shredded cabbage, and chopped green onion.", "Stir-fry until cabbage is soft and translucent.", "Season with soy sauce and black pepper."]

name: Classic Cheeseburger
instructions: ["Form ground beef into patties, season with salt and pepper.", "Sear patties in hot cast iron skillet 3 minutes per side, melt cheese on top.", "Serve in toasted buns with fresh onion and tomato slices."]

name: Crispy Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: ["Butter the outside of two slices of bread.", "Place cheese slices between unbuttered sides.", "Cook in skillet over medium-low heat until golden brown on both sides and cheese is completely melted."]

name: BLT Sandwich
instructions: ["Cook bacon slices until crisp, drain on paper towels.", "Toast bread slices and spread with mayonnaise.", "Layer crisp lettuce, ripe sliced tomato, and bacon between toast."]

name: Homestyle Macaroni and Cheese
instructions: ["Cook macaroni until al dente.", "Melt butter, whisk in flour, and slowly add milk to create a smooth roux.", "Stir in shredded cheddar until melted, fold in warm pasta."]

name: Classic Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: ["Saute diced onion, carrot, and celery until soft.", "Add chicken broth and shredded cooked chicken.", "Simmer with egg noodles until noodles are tender, season with salt and pepper."]

name: Tuna Melt on Toast
instructions: ["Mix flaked tuna with diced red onion and seasoning.", "Spoon tuna mixture onto buttered bread slices and top with cheese.", "Toast under broiler or in skillet until bread is crisp and cheese melted."]

name: Loaded Baked Potato
instructions: ["Bake whole potato at 200 C for 45 minutes until tender.", "Slice open and fluff the inside with a fork.", "Top with crispy bacon bits, melted cheddar, a dollop of sour cream, and green onion."]

name: Shepherd's Pie Skillet
instructions: ["Boil and mash potatoes with butter.", "Brown ground beef with diced onion, carrots, and peas.", "Top beef mixture with mashed potatoes and broil until top is golden brown."]

name: Lemon Herb Baked Cod
instructions: ["Place cod fillets in a baking dish.", "Melt butter with minced garlic, fresh lemon juice, and parsley; pour over fish.", "Bake at 190 C for 15 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes with a fork."]

name: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: ["Sear peeled shrimp in oil until pink, remove from skillet.", "Saute peas, diced carrots, and scramble in egg.", "Add cooked rice, return shrimp to pan, and toss with soy sauce."]

name: Salmon Avocado Rice Bowl
instructions: ["Pan-sear seasoned salmon fillet until medium-rare, then flake.", "Place cooked sushi or jasmine rice in a bowl.", "Arrange salmon, sliced avocado, and cucumber on top, drizzle with soy sauce."]

name: Garlic Butter Mussels
instructions: ["Saute minced garlic in foaming butter in a large pot.", "Add cleaned mussels and a splash of water, cover and steam 5 minutes until shells open.", "Discard any unopened shells, finish with fresh lemon, serve with crusty bread."]

name: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
instructions: ["Saute onion and garlic in butter.", "Add cauliflower florets and broth, simmer until tender.", "Puree with immersion blender until velvety smooth, stir in milk, season to taste."]

name: Moroccan Spiced Chickpea Stew
instructions: ["Saute chopped onion and cubed sweet potato in olive oil.", "Add drained chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, and warm spices (cumin, cinnamon).", "Simmer 25 minutes, fold in fresh spinach until wilted."]

name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
instructions: ["Melt butter in saucepan, saute sliced mushrooms, onion, and garlic until caramelized.", "Add broth and simmer 15 minutes.", "Blend half the soup for texture, stir in heavy cream, and season with black pepper."]

name: Spicy Sausage and Kale Soup
instructions: ["Brown sliced Italian sausage in soup pot and remove excess oil.", "Add diced onion, minced garlic, and cubed potatoes with broth; simmer until potatoes are tender.", "Stir in torn kale and simmer 5 minutes."]

name: Thai Red Coconut Curry with Chicken
instructions: ["Simmer red curry paste in a splash of coconut milk until fragrant.", "Add sliced chicken breast and simmer until cooked through.", "Add sliced bell peppers and onion, pour in remaining coconut milk, serve over jasmine rice."]

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Quinoa and Black Beans
instructions: ["Cook quinoa and mix with black beans, diced tomatoes, and spices.", "Cut bell peppers in half and remove seeds.", "Stuff peppers with quinoa filling, top with cheese, and bake at 190 C for 30 minutes."]

name: Zucchini Ribbon Pasta with Garlic and Lemon
instructions: ["Shave zucchini into long ribbons using a vegetable peeler.", "Saute sliced garlic gently in olive oil.", "Toss zucchini ribbons in hot garlic oil for 2 minutes, finish with lemon juice and grated cheese."]

name: Crispy Baked Tofu with Broccoli
instructions: ["Toss cubed tofu with soy sauce and bake at 200 C for 25 minutes until crunchy.", "Steam broccoli florets until bright green.", "Serve crispy tofu and broccoli over rice with extra soy sauce."]

name: Lentil Bolognese Pasta
instructions: ["Saute finely diced onion, carrot, and garlic in olive oil.", "Add rinsed brown lentils, crushed tomatoes, and vegetable broth; simmer 25 minutes.", "Toss hearty lentil ragu with cooked pasta."]

name: Roasted Cauliflower Steaks with Garlic Herb Oil
instructions: ["Slice cauliflower head into thick steaks.", "Brush both sides with olive oil, minced garlic, and salt.", "Roast at 210 C for 25 minutes flipping halfway, finish with squeeze of fresh lemon."]

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Quesadilla
instructions: ["Roast or microwave cubed sweet potato until soft, mash slightly with black beans.", "Spread sweet potato bean mixture on tortilla and top with cheese.", "Fold and toast in skillet until crisp and golden."]

name: Eggs Benedict on English Muffin
instructions: ["Toast bread or English muffins, crisp bacon slices.", "Poach eggs in simmering water with a drop of vinegar.", "Whisk melted butter, egg yolk, and lemon juice into hollandaise sauce, assemble and serve immediately."]

name: Blueberry Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: ["Whisk flour, egg, milk, and melted butter into a light pancake batter.", "Pour batter onto hot griddle, drop fresh blueberries into each pancake.", "Flip when bubbles pop, cook until golden, serve with syrup."]

name: Vegetable and Cheese Egg Muffins
instructions: ["Chop spinach, bell peppers, and onion finely.", "Whisk eggs with a splash of milk, salt, and pepper.", "Distribute vegetables and cheese into muffin tins, pour egg over, and bake at 180 C for 18 minutes."]

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
instructions: ["Toast slices of whole wheat bread until firm.", "Spread with creamy peanut butter.", "Top with sliced ripe bananas and a drizzle of honey."]

name: Breakfast Burrito with Sausage and Eggs
instructions: ["Brown breakfast sausage in pan and remove.", "Scramble eggs softly in the same skillet.", "Roll sausage, eggs, salsa, and shredded cheese inside a warm tortilla."]

name: Warm Bacon Spinach Salad
instructions: ["Crisp diced bacon in skillet, remove bacon and keep warm drippings.", "Whisk vinegar and a pinch of sugar into warm bacon fat to make dressing.", "Toss fresh baby spinach, hard-boiled egg slices, and red onion with warm dressing."]

name: Apple Walnut Salad with Goat Cheese
instructions: ["Wash and dry crisp salad greens.", "Thinly slice sweet apples and crumble soft cheese over greens.", "Dress with lemon vinaigrette made of olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper."]

name: Chickpea and Avocado Salad
instructions: ["Rinse and drain canned chickpeas.", "Dice avocado, ripe tomatoes, and English cucumber.", "Gently combine with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and freshly cracked black pepper."]

name: Crispy Garlic Roasted Green Beans
instructions: ["Trim fresh green beans and pat dry.", "Toss beans with olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper.", "Roast at 220 C for 15 minutes until edges are blistered and tender, squeeze lemon juice over top."]

name: Cilantro Lime Rice
instructions: ["Cook long grain white rice until fluffy.", "Stir in melted butter and minced garlic while warm.", "Finish with freshly squeezed lime juice and fluff with fork."]

name: Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges
instructions: ["Cut sweet potatoes into thick wedges.", "Toss with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt.", "Roast at 200 C for 25 minutes flipping once until caramelized."]

name: Garlic Butter Sauteed Asparagus
instructions: ["Snap woody ends off fresh asparagus spears.", "Melt butter in skillet, add minced garlic and asparagus.", "Saute over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until tender-crisp, finish with lemon juice."]

name: Steamed Garlic Edamame
instructions: ["Boil or steam whole edamame pods for 5 minutes.", "Toss warm pods with minced garlic, a splash of soy sauce, and sea salt.", "Serve warm as an appetizer."]

name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites with Potatoes
instructions: ["Parboil cubed potatoes and brown in skillet with butter until crisp.", "Cut sirloin steak into bite-sized cubes, season with salt and pepper.", "Sear steak in roaring hot butter with garlic for 3 minutes, toss with potatoes."]

name: Baked Lemon Pepper Chicken Wings
instructions: ["Pat chicken wings completely dry.", "Toss with melted butter, coarse black pepper, lemon zest, and salt.", "Bake at 220 C on wire rack for 35 minutes until skin is golden and ultra crispy."]

name: One-Pot Sausage and Penne Pasta
instructions: ["Brown sliced sausage in a large Dutch oven with garlic.", "Add dry penne pasta, crushed tomatoes, and broth.", "Simmer covered 12 minutes until pasta is tender, stir in splash of cream."]

name: Cheddar and Bacon Stuffed Chicken Breast
instructions: ["Cut a horizontal pocket into chicken breasts.", "Stuff pocket with shredded cheddar, cooked bacon crumbles, and garlic.", "Sear chicken in pan to brown, transfer to 190 C oven for 20 minutes until cooked through."]

name: Honey Garlic Glazed Salmon
instructions: ["Whisk honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, and lemon juice in a small bowl.", "Pan-sear salmon fillets skin-side up for 4 minutes, flip.", "Pour honey garlic glaze over salmon, simmer until glaze thickens and coats fish."]
